components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink rubber-stamp CTA: rotated, roughened edge, hard offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; border: 2px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(-0.6deg); background: #b1272d; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #8a1e23; transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8a1e23; transform: rotate(-0.6deg) scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a3e72; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Blue outline ink stamp, same roughened-edge family as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; border: 2px solid #1a3e72; background: transparent; color: #1a3e72; cursor: pointer; transform: rotate(-0.6deg); transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1a3e72; color: #fff; }

components.name: Note Card
components.description: Taped, individually rotated correspondence card — the About section's non-uniform alternative to a 3-up icon grid.
components.html:
由你主辦

邀請名單、話題深淺、場地形式，全部由你話事，我哋只提供意見。
components.css: .ds-note-card { position: relative; background: #fbf8f0; border: 1px solid #d9c8a3; padding: 1.5rem 1rem 1rem; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(25,20,10,0.08); transform: rotate(-1.6deg); } .ds-note-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 50%; width: 64px; height: 22px; margin-left: -32px; background: #b1272d; opacity: 0.75; transform: rotate(3deg); } .ds-note-card h3 { color: #8a1e23; font-family: 'Noto Serif HK', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; } .ds-note-card p { font-size: 0.95rem; color: #55493c; margin: 0; }

components.name: Safety Card
components.description: Pinned-notice card — a tack dot replaces the banned colored side border.
components.html:
家庭衝突風險

討論死亡同晚期照顧意願，喺華人家庭入面容易觸發抗拒。
components.css: .ds-safety-card { position: relative; background: #fbf8f0; border: 1px solid #d9c8a3; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-safety-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -7px; left: 1.5rem; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #b1272d; box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgba(25,20,10,0.35); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky paper header with a dashed rule; collapses to a toggled sheet under 720px.
components.html: 關於呢件事開始籌備
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-nav a { color: #2b2620; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #b1272d; } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem; border-radius: 6px; background: #b1272d; color: #fff !important; }

narrative.overview: The site is not a page about a dinner; it is the letter the visitor has been meaning to send. Every surface borrows its materials from Hong Kong par-avion correspondence — onion-skin paper, the diagonal red-and-blue airmail chevron, ink rubber stamps, typewritten postmarks — because the product's actual mechanism is a host finally saying, in person, what a letter would otherwise carry unsent. The world was chosen over the roll's own assignment ('The Long Table,' a mahjong-table system) specifically because it dramatizes the product's central promise more directly, at the acknowledged cost of being the more expected reach for a correspondence metaphor. It replaces the incumbent cream/red/teal 'modern nonprofit landing page' entirely.
keyCharacteristics: Every section is a distinct piece of mail — sealed aerogramme, pinned notice, postage-denomination card — never a generic rounded panel.
The hero visibly unseals on load, skipped under reduced motion.
Controls are ink rubber stamps: rotated, roughened at the edge via an SVG turbulence filter.
Kickers/eyebrows are refused outright; the hero's eyebrow copy survives as a diagonal postal endorsement stamp instead.
Bilingual by construction — every postal motif holds both Traditional Chinese and English without truncating either.

rules.name: The Rationed Red Rule
rules.body: Airmail red never decorates; it appears only on the primary action, the selected state, or the topic that needs the most weight (ACP). A page with red on more than a handful of elements has drifted.

rules.name: The One-Voice-Per-Material Rule
rules.body: Noto Serif HK speaks; Noto Sans HK explains; Special Elite stamps. No component borrows a second family for emphasis.

rules.name: The Object-Not-Panel Rule
rules.body: A card earns depth by being a specific postal object before it earns a shadow. Reach for material first.

dos: Do ration airmail red to the primary action, the selected state, and the ACP template.
Do give every card family its own fastening motif (tape, grommet, pin, deckle-clip) rather than reusing one card shell everywhere.
Do keep Special Elite confined to postal/numeric chrome.
Do animate via filter/clip-path/transform, never width/height/margin.
donts: Don't use a kicker or eyebrow pill above any heading.
Don't put a colored border-left/border-right above 1px on any card.
Don't introduce a large soft-app border radius (12px+) anywhere.
Don't let the diagonal hero stamp's fixed rotated box run past the sheet edge — verify both languages at the narrowest supported width whenever its copy changes.
